exposure: Major healthcare policy change in public hospitals (changed demand and supply side incentives for C-section procedures)
cohort: The study included all deliveries occurring in public hospitals in Iran affected by the 2014 healthcare reform.
finding: The healthcare policy significantly reduced the national C-section rate by 6 percentage points, primarily driven by first-birth mothers, without adverse effects on Apgar score, hospitalisation, or mortality, but with an increase in gestation length and birth weight.
mod_finding: The policy led to a 6 percentage point reduction in the national C-section rate.
